act.long_title: An Act to define and amend the law relating to certain kinds of specific relief.

licence: Published with commentary and other original matter under s.52(1)(q)(ii), Copyright Act 1957.

section.heading: Specific relief to be granted only for enforcing individual civil rights and not for enforcing penal laws
section.html: Specific relief can be granted only for the purpose of enforcing individual civil rights and not for the mere purpose of enforcing a penal law.
section.text: Specific relief can be granted only for the purpose of enforcing individual civil rights and not for the mere purpose of enforcing a penal law.
